description: This file defines the EmpDependent class, representing a dependent entity related to an employee within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for dependent details such as name, relationship, relationship type, and date of birth, along with getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes validation for relationship types.

classes.name: EmpDependent
classes.description: Represents an employee's dependent with related details such as name, relationship, and date of birth, mapped to the database with ORM annotations, including validation and decorator traits.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this dependent.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object associated with this dependent.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number identifier for this dependent.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number identifier for this dependent.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dependent.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dependent.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the type of relationship, e.g., 'child' or 'other'.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the type of relationship; validates against predefined constants.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the date of birth of the dependent.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the date of birth of the dependent.
